title: Traditional Ukrainian Dumplings with Mushroom Gravy
description: A hearty Ukrainian dish featuring pillowy dumplings served with a rich mushroom gravy, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Carefully add the Ukrainian dumplings to the boiling water and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the cooked dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt the old-fashioned butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Sprinkle the pillowy flour over the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the water to the skillet, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens.
Return the cooked dumplings to the skillet and toss them in the mushroom gravy.
Serve the dumplings hot, topped with additional mushroom gravy if desired.
